What stood out the most was his deep knowledge of sports. It felt like he truly understands the game and the technical side of the equipment, which made it much easier for me to choose the right product with confidence.

Decathlon should definitely have more employees like Harman Padda — people who are passionate, knowledgeable, and truly focused on helping customers.
